svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-2-help-request" name="process-view-level-2-help-request"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant FE as Frontend
 participant IN as Infrastructure
 participant BE as Backend
 participant AI as AI provider [PENDING]
 actor O as Control-room operator (P2)
 P->>FE: Submits help request (category, location, optional text)
 FE->>IN: Submit help request [HTTPS/JSON] (API gateway)
 IN->>BE: Forward
 BE->>IN: Save request \"Awaiting triage\" and its event (database)
 BE-->>FE: Request received
 FE-->>P: Request received
 IN->>BE: Deliver \"help request submitted\" event (message broker)
 BE->>AI: Ask for triage suggestion
 alt AI answers in time
 AI-->>BE: Suggested category and priority
 BE->>IN: Save suggestion (database)
 else AI unavailable after retries
 BE->>IN: Mark request \"Not triaged\" (database)
 end
 O->>FE: Opens the request list
 loop Every few seconds
 FE->>IN: Get request list [HTTPS/JSON] (API gateway)
 IN->>BE: Forward
 BE->>IN: Read requests of this event (database)
 BE-->>FE: Requests with \"Awaiting triage\", suggestion or \"Not triaged\"
 FE-->>O: Shows the list
 end
 Note over O,BE: The operator can act on a request at any time, without waiting for the AI
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
